context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly renders a validated evaluation into a finding record using context-file, preserves the recommendation verbatim, regenerates the index, and confirms discoverability before reporting completion.

checklist.name: Uses context-file skill
checklist.description: Finding written via context-file, not a hand-rolled file bypassing it

checklist.name: All four sections present
checklist.description: Blockquote summary, Summary table, Detail subsections, Recommended Action all present in order

checklist.name: Citations in Detail
checklist.description: Each Detail subsection carries its citation, not just a restated verdict

checklist.name: Verbatim recommendation
checklist.description: single_action reproduced verbatim, not paraphrased or softened

checklist.name: Index regenerated
checklist.description: context-index run after writing the finding

checklist.name: Discoverability confirmed
checklist.description: New finding confirmed present in the regenerated index before reporting done
